create_anthropic_files_config: create an AnthropicFilesConfig instance to transform requests and responses for the Anthropic Files API
transform_create_file_request: transform a create file request into multipart form data for uploading files to the Anthropic Files API
transform_retrieve_file_request: transform a retrieve file request into the correct Anthropic API URL for a given file ID
transform_list_files_request: transform a list files request into the Anthropic API URL with optional purpose filter parameter
transform_delete_file_request: transform a delete file request into the correct Anthropic API URL for removing a file by ID
